stalls.where: 林森路一段276號（夜市後段）
stalls.summaryZh: 大東最常被提到的攤位，排骨酥香帶淡淡藥材味，無骨肉條方便邊走邊吃，很多人吃完還外帶。
stalls.summaryEn: Dadong's most-cited stall: fragrant fried pork with a light herbal note; the boneless strips are easy to snack on and many people buy extra to go.

sources.title: 食尚玩家｜8大台南夜市精選：營業時間表、必吃美食攻略
蕃薯藤旅遊｜台南夜市美食推薦
TVBS新聞｜網友熱議夜市排行

stalls.summaryZh: 在地人熟悉的老牌煎餃，皮煎得酥、餡料紮實，可沾自製蔥辣醬油；也會在武聖夜市出攤。
stalls.summaryEn: A local favorite with crisp-bottomed skins and firm filling, served with house scallion-chili soy sauce. Also sets up at Wusheng.

sources.title: 食尚玩家｜8大台南夜市精選：營業時間表、必吃美食攻略

stalls.summaryZh: 從阿嬤柑仔店起家的古早味紅茶牛奶，不會太甜，過去以復古袋裝出名，現多改杯裝。
stalls.summaryEn: Old-style black tea with milk that grew out of a grandma's grocery shop; not too sweet. Once known for retro bags, now mostly served in cups.

sources.title: 旅圖 ReadyGo（LINE TODAY）｜大東夜市、大東東夜市美食

stalls.summaryZh: 先炸後炭烤的厚切雞排，肉汁多；加泰式或蜂蜜芥末醬會更鹹，怕鹹可選原味醬燒。
stalls.summaryEn: A thick cutlet fried then charcoal-grilled, very juicy; the Thai and honey-mustard sauces make it saltier, so the plain soy glaze is the safer pick.

sources.title: 旅圖 ReadyGo（LINE TODAY）｜大東夜市、大東東夜市美食

stalls.summaryZh: 溫熱黑糖珍珠配冰鮮奶，珍珠Q彈、奶香濃，一進夜市就看得到；總店在東寧路。
stalls.summaryEn: Warm brown-sugar pearls with cold fresh milk, chewy and creamy, right at the entrance. The main shop is on Dongning Road.

sources.title: 蕃薯藤旅遊｜台南夜市美食推薦

stalls.summaryZh: 大火快炒、醬色深、鑊氣重，用外帶盒裝好邊走邊吃；瑞豐夜市也有同名攤。
stalls.summaryEn: Wok-fired noodles with dark sauce and strong wok aroma, packed in takeaway boxes for walking. A same-name stall also operates at Ruifeng.

sources.title: 蕃薯藤旅遊｜台南夜市美食推薦

stalls.summaryZh: 入口旁常大排長龍的地瓜球，現炸現吃最好，一人一袋剛剛好。
stalls.summaryEn: A sweet potato ball stall by the entrance that often has a long line; best eaten hot, about one bag per person.

stalls.summaryZh: 小巧銅鑼燒口味多、不會太甜，價格親民，適合穿插在鹹食之間。
stalls.summaryEn: Small dorayaki in lots of flavors, not too sweet and cheap, a nice break between savory snacks.

stalls.summaryZh: 藥膳湯頭帶甘甜，可加麵線或麵，天冷時特別受歡迎。
stalls.summaryEn: Herbal pork soup with a gently sweet broth, add noodles or mee-sua if you like. Especially popular on cool nights.

sources.title: 旅圖 ReadyGo（LINE TODAY）｜大東夜市、大東東夜市美食

stalls.summaryZh: 手桿蔥油餅外酥內Q，常排長隊且每天賣完就收。
stalls.summaryEn: Hand-rolled scallion pancakes, crisp outside and chewy inside; long lines and it closes once sold out.

sources.title: 旅圖 ReadyGo（LINE TODAY）｜大東夜市、大東東夜市美食
